instruction: Send my transaction date information in my records to the auditor.

steps.result: Send my transaction date information in my records to the auditor.

arguments.command: awk -F, '{header=0; for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="value_on" || $i=="txn_date") header=1; if(header){id=0; d=0; amt=0; width=NF; for(i=1;i<=NF;i++){ if($i=="entry_ref") id=i; if($i=="amount") amt=i; if($i=="value_on" || $i=="txn_date") d=i } next} if(id && d && amt && NF==width) print $id","$amt","$d}' /workspace/financial_records_folder/transactions_2025_01.csv /workspace/financial_records_folder/transactions_2025_02.csv /workspace/financial_records_folder/transactions_2025_03_part1.csv /workspace/financial_records_folder/transactions_2025_03_part2.csv /workspace/financial_records_folder/transactions_2025_04.csv /workspace/financial_records_folder/transactions_2025_05.csv /workspace/financial_records_folder/transactions_2025_06.csv

emails.subject: Transaction dates for the review
emails.body:
Hi Amina,

We're closing out the first-half review of your accounts. Could you send me the transaction dates from your January–June 2025 records when you get a chance?

Thanks,
Marta Chen
Auditor, Northstar Audit
